messages:
deploy-bot: SBOM + vuln scan complete for `release/2026-03-20` (build b4521). Results: variance vs baseline detected. Summary: 1 HIGH, 3 MED, 5 LOW. Full report: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/b4521/sbom-report
```
HIGH: CVE-2026-3456 (transitive) - crate `dep-x` 1.2.3 -> introduced via `tooling-lib`
MED: CVE-2026-2001 (transitive) - `parser-y`
MED: CVE-2026-2100 (direct) - `json-helpers`
MED: CVE-2026-2200 (transitive) - `websocket-client`
```

elena (release): ack, thanks. Is the high vulnerability reachable in prod runtime? :eyes:

matt (sec): quick read: CVE-2026-3456 is a deserialization issue; exploit requires untrusted input to `tooling-lib`'s CLI path. As bundled it looks low exposure — not on public request path. Still a high severity. Recommend mitigation or compensating controls before GA.

jia (sre): we don't call `tooling-lib` from runtime services, it's used in build pipeline. Confirmed no runtime use in prod images. Can we confirm it's not bundled into server runtime container?

matt (sec): double-checking image layers... looks like `tooling-lib` is only in the builder stage, not the final runtime image. So runtime exposure = 0.

elena (release): good. That reduces immediate risk. What about the MED `json-helpers` (direct)? Is that in runtime?

matt (sec): `json-helpers` is used by `ingest` and `batch-embed`. But the `/embed` endpoint validates payload length and schema; exploit vector requires malformed nested types we don't accept. Risk = medium but mitigatable. Suggest runtime WAF rule plus rate-limited retries monitoring.

ana (product): typo — i'm ana (product). From product POV: customers on Dedicated care about any high/med. Need clear release notes & an FAQ entry. If you proceed, communicate mitigation and timeline for fix.

kevin (legal): license scan shows `parser-y` (MED) has a 3rd-party attribution requirement. We need to include the proper attribution in OSS notices before GA. Not a blocker but needs a PR to docs.

elena (release): proposed decision: proceed with change window tonight with conditions: 1) confirm final runtime image does not include `tooling-lib` (matt + jia), 2) add runtime WAF rule and an alert for malformed JSON patterns (jia), 3) add OSS attribution and release-note blurb (kevin + ana), 4) schedule hotfix branch for `json-helpers` upgrade and plan a canary rollout within 48h (dev team). Any objections?

matt (sec): +1 to that flow. I'll sign off on security with those mitigations in place.

jia (sre): will add the WAF rule and a synthetic monitor producing alerts on the malformed payload pattern. ETA 2 hours. I'll post the rule id in this thread when ready.

kevin (legal): i'll prepare the OSS attribution text and drop a PR to `docs/legal/oss-notices.md`. ETA 3 hours.

ana (product): I'll craft the release-note blurb: short + transparent. Will ping marketing for the customer-facing blurb.

elena (release): devs — please open a hotfix branch for `json-helpers` and `parser-y` upgrades and tag it `hotfix/b4521-sbom-2026-03-20`. We won't block GA on the backport but want a tracked plan.

dev-bot: Created issue RW-4207 "hotfix: upgrade json-helpers + parser-y" and hotfix branch `hotfix/b4521-sbom-2026-03-20` (assignee: @team-core).

elena (release): with all that, i'm going to mark change-window = green and proceed with rollout at 23:00 UTC. If any of the mitigations fail to land, hold and escalate. :shipit:

matt (sec): I'll add a post-release scan job to run every 2h for 24h and notify #incidents if exploitation indicators show up.

jia (sre): WAF rule created: `waf-rule-1379`. Monitoring alert folded into `incidents` on failure.

kevin (legal): PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/889

ana (product): release notes draft: "Security: SBOM scan identified a high-severity issue in a build-stage tool that does not run in production. Runtime mitigations have been applied and a hotfix is scheduled. See KB link." I'll paste final copy once marketing eyes it.

elena (release): thanks team. I'll post a short blurb in the release channel once deployment completes and link this thread. Closing thread for pre-release decisions.

matt (sec): :thumbsup:

jia (sre): proceeding with rollout monitor.

elena (release): last check-in: all mitigations green, proceeding.
